pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa bhikkhunūpassayaṃ nissāya yavakhettaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.3: bhikkhuniyo uccārampi passāvampi saṅkārampi vighāsampi harite chaḍḍenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.4: atha kho so brāhmaṇo ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo amhākaṃ yavakhettaṃ dūsessantī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa brāhmaṇassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.8: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo uccārampi passāvampi saṅkārampi vighāsampi harite chaḍḍessantī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo uccārampi passāvampi saṅkārampi vighāsampi harite chaḍḍentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.12: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo uccārampi passāvampi saṅkārampi vighāsampi harite chaḍḍessanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:1.15.1: “yā pana bhikkhunī uccāraṃ vā passāvaṃ vā saṅkāraṃ vā vighāsaṃ vā harite chaḍḍeyya vā chaḍḍāpeyya vā, pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.1.12: calakāni vā aṭṭhikāni vā ucciṭṭhodakaṃ vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.1.14: pubbannaṃ aparannaṃ yaṃ manussānaṃ upabhogaparibhogaṃ ropimaṃ .
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.1.19: sakiṃ āṇattā bahukampi chaḍḍeti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.2.1: harite haritasaññā chaḍḍeti vā chaḍḍāpeti vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.2.2: harite vematikā chaḍḍeti vā chaḍḍāpeti vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc9:2.2.3: harite aharitasaññā chaḍḍeti vā chaḍḍāpeti vā āpatti pācittiyassa.
